analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.powerDaysDesc: Day + time combos where you finish the most
analytics.completeForInsights: Complete some tasks to unlock productivity insights
analytics.noHistoryMsg: Complete some tasks to enable capacity forecasting.
analytics.recNoData: Complete a few tasks to unlock personalised insights!
analytics.recStreak: 🔥 {{n}}-day streak! Your peak window: {{day}} {{slot}}s — protect that time.
analytics.recOverdue: {{pct}}% of open tasks are overdue. Tackle them on {{day}} {{slot}}s — that's your peak time.
analytics.recWeekend: Weekend warrior! {{wknd}} tasks on weekends vs {{wkdy}} on weekdays.
analytics.recOnTime: You deliver {{rate}}% on time — excellent! Schedule heavy tasks on {{day}}s.
analytics.recRestart: You hit a {{best}}-day streak before. {{day}} {{slot}}s are your sweet spot — restart then!
analytics.recDefault: Your peak time: {{day}} {{slot}}s. Schedule Critical and High-priority tasks in that window!
analytics.fcSlightlyAbove: 📋 Slightly above capacity — manageable with good prioritisation.
analytics.fcOnTrack: ✅ Workload is within capacity — you're on track.
analytics.fcNoDue: ✅ No tasks due in the next {{n}} days — great time to plan ahead.
analytics.fcPredHigh: {{count}} task(s) due in {{n}} days. You typically complete ~{{avg}} tasks in this period.
analytics.fcPredMed: {{count}} task(s) due in {{n}} days, slightly above your average of ~{{avg}}.
analytics.fcPredLow: {{count}} task(s) due in {{n}} days, well within your average capacity of ~{{avg}}.
analytics.fcPredNone: Schedule is clear. Your average capacity is ~{{avg}} tasks per {{n}} days.
analytics.fcSuggestHigh: Consider rescheduling low-priority tasks. Focus Critical and High items first.
analytics.fcSuggestMed: Try completing Medium and High tasks early in the week to avoid a crunch.
analytics.fcSuggestLow: Keep your current rhythm. You could take on {{extra}} more tasks comfortably.
analytics.noCompletedTasks: No completed tasks for this period
analytics.methodCapacityDesc: The Risk Coefficient = PlannedLoad / AvgCapacity. Tasks weighted: High × 1.5, Medium × 1.0, Low × 0.5. History window: last 30 days.
analytics.methodPowerDaysDesc: Cross-references day of week × time slot (Morning 6–11, Afternoon 12–16, Evening 17–21, Night). Top 3 combos ranked by completion frequency.
analytics.methodStreaksDesc: Consecutive days with ≥ 1 completion. Alive if last active day = today or yesterday. On-time rate: completedAt ≤ deadline among Done tasks.
analytics.methodTrendDesc: Daily completed task count over the chosen window (7 / 30 / 90 days). Distribution chart shows upcoming weighted task load per day.
